# pedicura

## GRAVEYARD SHIFT — at Bergmann's Workshop

An original browser-based survival horror game in the "night watch" genre.
You are the night technician at an animatronic repair workshop. The machines
on the floor still run their old routines after midnight. Survive 12 AM – 6 AM,
five nights in a row (plus an unlockable Overtime night).

**Everything is generated by code** — all graphics are drawn procedurally on a
`<canvas>` and all audio is synthesized with WebAudio. There are no image or
sound files, and no external dependencies.

### Play

Open `index.html` in any modern browser, or serve the folder:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
# then visit http://localhost:8000
```

### How to play

- **Mouse** pans your view of the office. Click the panels beside each
  doorway: **DOOR** seals it, **LIGHT** checks the hallway outside.
- The strip at the bottom (or **M** / **Space**) opens the **cameras**;
  keys **1–9** switch feeds. **Q/E** toggle the doors, **A/D** the lights.
- Everything you switch on drains **power** faster. At 0%, the dark decides.
- **STRIX** (owl) hunts the left door. **HOWLER** (wolf) and **WART** (toad)
  hunt the right. WART freezes while his camera is on your screen.
- **RUST** (cat) leaves the Maintenance Bay (CAM 5) if you stop checking it —
  if the bay is empty, close the west door immediately.
- Progress (furthest night, Overtime unlock) is saved in your browser.

### Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` / `style.css` | page shell |
| `js/audio.js` | procedural WebAudio sound engine |
| `js/art.js` | all art: characters, office, camera rooms, CRT effects |
| `js/game.js` | game loop, AI, power/time systems, UI, save data |

*Graveyard Shift is an original work inspired by the point-and-click
night-survival genre. It is not affiliated with, and contains no assets from,
any existing franchise.*
